title: Avoid redundant heap allocation and take slice &[u8]
initial_code: pub fn compute_checksum(data: &Vec<u8>) -> u64 { data.iter().map(|b| *b as u64).sum() }
instruction: Refactor `compute_checksum` to take a borrowed slice `&[u8]` instead of `&Vec<u8>` to satisfy clippy `ptr_arg`.
expected_fixed_code: pub fn compute_checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u64 { data.iter().map(|b| *b as u64).sum() }

title: Implement clean domain error with thiserror
instruction: Implement `thiserror::Error` for `DataError` with descriptive message templates for each variant without custom boilerplate.
expected_fixed_code:
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum DataError {
    #[error("item not found")]
    NotFound,
    #[error("invalid data: {0}")]
    Invalid(String),
}

title: Exhaustive matching without catch-all wildcard
initial_code:
pub enum Action { Read, Write, Delete }
pub fn is_mutation(a: Action) -> bool { match a { Action::Read => false, _ => true } }
instruction: Refactor `is_mutation` to explicitly enumerate all enum variants (`Action::Write | Action::Delete => true`) rather than using catch-all `_`.
expected_fixed_code:
pub enum Action { Read, Write, Delete }
pub fn is_mutation(a: Action) -> bool { match a { Action::Read => false, Action::Write | Action::Delete => true } }

title: Preallocate known capacity with Vec::with_capacity
initial_code: pub fn duplicate_items(items: &[String]) -> Vec<String> { let mut v = Vec::new(); for item in items { v.push(item.clone()); } v }
instruction: Refactor `duplicate_items` to pre-allocate `Vec::with_capacity(items.len())` before iterating to avoid dynamic reallocations.
expected_fixed_code: pub fn duplicate_items(items: &[String]) -> Vec<String> { let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(items.len()); for item in items { v.push(item.clone()); } v }

title: Return Result instead of unwrap in library code
instruction: Refactor `parse_port` to return `Result<u16, std::num::ParseIntError>` using `?` instead of unwrap.
expected_fixed_code: pub fn parse_port(s: &str) -> Result<u16, std::num::ParseIntError> { s.parse::<u16>() }
